intro.text: Rain on the glass. The Hotel Meridian's vault is open, and a twelve-carat ruby called the Crimson Star is gone.
The keycard system logs every door. I can't read it. You can. Ask the database the right questions and it will talk.

outro.text: Rook's alibi dies with a single query. A good detective never guesses when the data can answer.
The city goes quiet. Somewhere, a database is dreaming of its next case.

puzzles.briefing: Start with the vault door. Return the person_id of everyone who badged IN to the 'vault' after 22:00.
puzzles.hint: SELECT person_id FROM keycard_log WHERE door = 'vault' AND direction = 'in' AND ts > '22:00';
puzzles.solved: Three people went in after ten: ids 2, 4 and 5.

puzzles.briefing: Numbers don't testify. Give me the NAMES of those three. Join keycard_log to people.
puzzles.hint: JOIN people ON people.id = keycard_log.person_id, then keep the same WHERE conditions and select name.
puzzles.solved: Nina Cole, Desmond Rook, Marcus Hale. A housekeeper, a guest and the guard.

puzzles.briefing: Thieves don't tidy up. Of the vault entries, who badged IN to the vault but never badged OUT of it? Return their name.
puzzles.hint: Try: SELECT name FROM people WHERE id IN (SELECT person_id FROM keycard_log WHERE door='vault' AND direction='in') AND id NOT IN (SELECT person_id FROM keycard_log WHERE door='vault' AND direction='out');
puzzles.solved: Desmond Rook went in and never came out through that door. He told us he never left the bar.
